title: Refund Policy
content: Employees and customers can request a refund for eligible purchases within 30 days of the original purchase date.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund requests must include the order number and reason for the request. Approved refunds are normally processed within 5 business days.

title: Refund Policy
content: Enterprise customers may have different refund terms defined in their individual contracts.

title: Refund Policy
content: Digital products that have already been fully consumed may not qualify for a refund. The finance team is responsible for approving refund exceptions.

title: Employee Handbook
content: Employees receive 24 paid leave days per calendar year.

title: Employee Handbook
content: Leave requests should normally be submitted at least 3 working days before the planned leave. Emergency leave may be requested without the normal advance notice.

title: Employee Handbook
content: Employees should contact their manager for leave approval. Unused paid leave can be carried forward for up to 10 days into the following calendar year.

title: Employee Handbook
content: Public holidays are separate from the annual paid leave allowance.

title: Bonus Policy
content: Eligible employees may receive an annual performance bonus.

title: Bonus Policy
content: The standard performance bonus rate is 10 percent of eligible annual compensation.

title: Bonus Policy
content: Bonus eligibility depends on employee performance, role, and company performance. Employees must meet the eligibility requirements at the time bonuses are calculated.

title: Bonus Policy
content: The final bonus amount is subject to management approval. Contract employees may have different bonus arrangements.
